html:
source.txt retains the contents of the public table used by the main research. The snapshot contains 83 known solutions: puzzles 1–70, then 75–135 in steps of 5. This does not describe the current number of solved puzzles.

source.json records the URL, the download time on 30 October 2026, and the SHA-256 of the original bytes. Text-export line endings may have been normalized; original and exported hashes are distinguished in the manifest. Unknown keys are not observations of the generator.

The data and evidence files are byte-identical in the Russian and English editions. They are not translated.
